# C# Architecture Style

For capabilities, service registration, EF Core models, or extension members, follow `docs/contract-first-capability-architecture.md`. It defines the required C# 14 extension syntax, option-method registration API, explicit EF model configuration, responsibility-focused contracts, PostgreSQL Testcontainers seam, and MSBuild-first assembly metadata policy.
